untertitel: Times and appointments: four roles, one diary (in a group of four)

grammatik.regel: *on* + day (on Thursday), *at* + time (at half past four). *I'd like* ... is a polite way to say *I want* ... After *Can I* we use the base verb: Can I *have* a haircut?

redemittel.p1: *On* Thursday I'm in class until four.

soGehts: Cut pages 2 and 3 along the line: four cards. Each person takes one role: A and B are customers, C works at the reception desk, D is the hairdresser.
Read your role. Don't show your card!
A and B phone the salon one after the other. C looks for an appointment and asks D: "Is that OK?"
At the end, each customer has an appointment. Everybody writes the appointments down.
Fill in the group result together (page "Together") and tell the class.

schritte.anweisung: Read your role. Phone the salon.
schritte.ziel: You'd like an appointment for a haircut.
infos: You work Monday to Friday until six o'clock.
You are only free on Saturday.
On Saturday at twelve o'clock you have a party.

schritte.anweisung: Read your role. Phone the salon.
schritte.ziel: You'd like a haircut appointment this week.
infos: On Thursday you are free from three o'clock.
On Saturday you can come between ten and eleven.
You'd prefer to come on Saturday.
redemittel: Good, then I'll come on ... at ...

tipp.beispiel: There _is_ a free appointment *at* half past ten.

schritte.anweisung: Read your role. The phone is ringing.
schritte.ziel: Every customer gets an appointment. Always ask Mei if it's OK.
infos: Still free in the diary: Thursday 3.30 pm and 4.30 pm, Saturday 10.00 am, 10.30 am and 11.30 am.
redemittel: One moment, please. Mei, is that OK?

hinweise: Listen carefully: what time does the reception say?
Say "Yes, that's fine." or "No, sorry, that doesn't work."

schritte.anweisung: Read your role. The reception asks you.
schritte.ziel: You say when you can work.
infos: On Thursday you are in a class until four o'clock.
On Saturday you must leave at eleven o'clock: it's your daughter's birthday.
redemittel: On Thursday I'm in class until four.
On Saturday I must leave at eleven.

freiFragen: When are you free this week?
What do you do on Saturday at half past ten?

ergebnis.bericht: In our group Zofia has an appointment on ... at ..., and Kwame on ... at ...

gruppe.rotation: Round 2: pass your card to the left - new role, new conversation.

loesungen.antwort: Zofia: Saturday at 10:00 or 10:30 (only Saturday; at 11:30 Mei has already gone).
Kwame: Thursday at 16:30 (half past four) - at 15:30 Mei is still in class - or on Saturday the other time (10:00 / 10:30).
Not possible: Thursday 15:30 (class until 16:00) and Saturday 11:30 (Mei leaves at 11:00).
